title: Canonical recursive Project Filing System grammar
statement: Every governed canonical repository MUST be a recursive tree of directly nested Modules. Each Module MUST contain README.md, a valid contract.json, and at least one of _code/ or a direct child Module. Canonical child names MUST be lowercase snake_case. The exact reserved structural directories are _code/, _data/, _docs/, and _info/; every other leading-underscore entry is invalid. Direct entries resolve in order as Fortress structure, applicable scoped ecosystem structure, contract-marked child Module attempts, or invalid content. Module roots and _docs/ are closed. Project-defined Code MUST be flat unless a registered ecosystem profile owns mechanical namespace structure. Data and Info MUST be either flat or use the frozen role/[collection]/[part_000001] grammar at minimum necessary depth. Companion documentation presence and canonical naming/versioning MUST be complete.
rationale: One uniform recursive filing grammar maps Module ancestry directly to directory ancestry, makes the Fortress namespace visible through a reserved prefix, prevents hidden decomposition, distinguishes persisted inputs from derived outputs, permits ecosystem structure only through explicitly scoped profiles, scales human catalogs by collection, and removes arbitrary filesystem taxonomies.
failure_prevented: Unowned implementation islands, malformed or ambiguously named Module attempts, responsibility hidden beneath structural paths, missing Module contracts, reserved-name collisions, ecosystem-scope leakage, mixed flat/structured Elements, recursive data taxonomies, malformed version or partition folders, arbitrary documentation archives, and entropy-producing path aliases.
applicability: Every governed repository snapshot using canonical physical filing. Logical/freeform Modules remain governed by their explicit bindings and governance territories rather than canonical physical Element spelling. Ecosystem entries are admitted only by validated Standard-owned profiles with explicit scope and directory opacity.
evaluation: The Fortress core builds one authoritative Module index from direct contract markers after reserved-namespace and scoped-ecosystem precedence; validates lowercase snake_case names, case-fold uniqueness, Module authority, Element structure, Code flatness, closed docs, Data/Info role-collection-partition depth, minimum necessary levels, _vN versions, part_000001 partitions, and companion documentation; inventories every leaf exactly once; then projects normalized violations into findings without adding leaf files to the CCG.

finding.message: An observed path or inferred Module violates the canonical recursive repository grammar.

remediation: Converge paths to direct contract-marked child Modules and _code/_data/_docs/_info; use lowercase snake_case child names; keep source files directly beneath _code unless a registered mechanical profile applies; retain only canonical companion docs; use the shallowest canonical Data/Info role and optional collection; use one part_000001-style physical partition level; and remove or explicitly register ecosystem-required surfaces at their correct scope.
valid_example: A composite Module has README.md, contract.json, a direct child_module/, and _docs/modules_docs.md; an atomic child has flat _code/; a large dataset remains _data/dataset/historical_events_v3/part_000001/... without creating volume-only Modules.
invalid_example: A scripts/ island exists at a Module root, ChildModule/ violates naming, _cache/ claims the reserved namespace, nested .github/ exceeds its project-root scope, _code/parsing hides an architectural responsibility, or _data/schema/schemas adds a redundant level.
exception_policy: Only entries in the validated ecosystem filing-profile registry are exceptions. Profiles declare project-root or Module-root scope, may make directory subtrees opaque, and may not claim leading-underscore names. Repository-specific prose and arbitrary directory names cannot create exemptions.
history: Introduced during CHG-REPOSITORY-GRAMMAR-0007 as the canonical replacement for the earlier project-declared placement model.
Requires one Module contract and bidirectional modules_docs.md decomposition documentation.
Recognizes root .gitattributes as Git-supported integration authority needed to preserve canonical LF contract bytes across platforms.
Defines profile-owned ecosystem surfaces, flat Code, closed Docs, frozen Data/Info roles, one collection and partition level, _vN versions, and scalable machine inventory.
Simplified in 1.0.0-draft.2 so canonical Module ancestry maps directly to directory ancestry and Fortress structure occupies the reserved underscore namespace.
